Container.Name: Splunk-Enterprise
Container.Overview:
Splunk Enterprise from the official splunk/splunk image, as a single standalone instance: search, dashboards and alerts over logs and machine data.
Receives data from Splunk Universal Forwarders (port 9997), over the HTTP Event Collector (port 8088) or from files you add in the web UI (port 8000).
You must accept the Splunk General Terms and the license (two variables below) and set an admin password of at least 8 characters before the first start. Without a license file Splunk runs as a 60-day trial and then as Splunk Free (500 MB of data per day).
To install a specific version, replace "latest" in the repository with a tag such as splunk/splunk:10.2.6. The first start takes a few minutes.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: splunk siem log logs logging search analytics hec universal forwarder syslog
Container.Requires: Accept the Splunk General Terms and license (variables below) and set an admin password. About 4 GB of RAM and fast storage for the index.
Container.License: Splunk General Terms (Splunk Enterprise, proprietary); MIT (template)

Config.Name: Management port
Config.Description: REST API and management (HTTPS). Deployment server and the splunk CLI use it.

Config.Name: Forwarder receiving port
Config.Description: Data from Splunk Universal Forwarders. Receiving on 9997 is enabled automatically.

Config.Name: HTTP Event Collector port
Config.Description: HTTP Event Collector (HTTPS). Change the host side if 8088 is taken on your server. Create tokens in Settings, Data inputs, HTTP Event Collector.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Indexes and internal logs (/opt/splunk/var). Grows with the amount of data you index; put it on a pool with enough space.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Password for the user admin, at least 8 characters. Only used on the first start; change it later in the web UI.

Config.Name: Accept license
Config.Description: Enter --accept-license to accept the Splunk Enterprise license. The container does not start without it.

Config.Name: Accept Splunk General Terms
Config.Description: Enter --accept-sgt-current-at-splunk-com to accept the Splunk General Terms (https://www.splunk.com/en_us/legal/splunk-general-terms.html).

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Time zone of the container, e.g. Europe/Berlin.
